notes.title: New FREE game Questinarium has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26478329/86d832eda5d005b881324338104b90af4b76acd5.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi Linea players, Oxy949 is here with some great news![/b]

[h3]My new free game [b]Questinarium[/b], made in collaboration with Dymchick1 has been finally released! Check it out :)[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226070/Questinarium/

Have fun!

notes.title: Linea VR is out!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33019266/b0a460c4219a031927f60af768bf9fc5d4763115.png[/img]

[h1]Hi friends![/h1]

[b]KHB-Soft[/b]'s main dev [b]Oxy949[/b] here with great news!

Remastered VR-version of "[b]Linea, the Game[/b]" is finally available for playing. As I said before it was really fun to remake my old game for VR! And thanks you all for your feedback during beta-test.

Have fun and see you soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144100/Linea_VR

notes.title: Linea and Intralism. Let's unite!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11382713/d5a65a3f9fa852a8f29371ea5e730483ea540407.png[/img]

[h1][b]Good day, everyone! My name is Sharp and I am the Development Director of KHB-Soft Studio.[/b][/h1]

Linea, the Game was our first published project on Steam and it inspired our team to create something new.

The new project got the name Intralism and it became one of the newest rhythm games on Steam. 
[b]
Many Linea players haven't heard about the game and I suggest you to give it a try. Let's unite our communities![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/513510/Intralism/

[h1][b]About Intralism:[/b][/h1]

[b]●[/b] [b]Gameplay video:[/b]
https://youtu.be/ZK-jedvPxL0

[b]●[/b] [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=513510&browsesort=mostrecent&section=readytouseitems]More then 2000 levels with different music[/url][/b]

[b]●[/b] [b][url=https://intralism.khb-soft.ru/?page=ranks]Global ranks for passing levels[/url][/b]

[b]● In-game editor for user created content.  Both gameplay and visual effects.[/b]
 
[b]● Multiplayer Mode: up to 16 players per game.[/b]


[h1][b]Feel free to join Intralism Official Discord server: 
https://discord.gg/intralism[/b][/h1]

There you can ask questions about the game, be aware of latest news and changes, find players from your country and more! :)

[h1][b]The special Steam Group to support Intralism:[/b][/h1]
[b]https://steamcommunity.com/groups/IntralismDiscord[/b]


LET'S UNITE :lineasquare::bluesun:

____________________________

Regards,
Sharp.Nsk
Development Director of KHB-Soft
